text:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly field note — thanks to everyone who pushed the Dedicated autoscale improvements live last night. Short priorities this week: lock model-routing policy changes, finish Private GA security checklist, and push P99 latency for hosted text_gen under 220ms. Quick readout below.

Samira (VP Product): +1 on the routing freeze. PMs please flag any customer-facing changes by EOD Mon. We also need effort estimates for the Private pilot onboarding flow.

Ravi (Head of Eng): Eng will focus on a safe rollback path for recent routing experiments. Canaries planned Wed AM. KV-cache tuning patch is in review (PR #4521), aiming for deploy Tue PM.

Elena (Director, Reliability): Incident recap: Wed 03:14 UTC — embeddings pipeline saw a 12m tail due to checkpoint GC concurrency. Root cause is GC + concurrent restore. Mitigation: backported fix and added a GC circuit-breaker. Postmortem being drafted in #incidents.

Jordan (CFO): Finance note — platform usage is +28% MoM. If unit cost per token doesn't fall ~8% next quarter, we need to revisit tier pricing or reserved capacity incentives. Ops + Product, please surface quick wins on quantization and batching.

OpsBot: Deploy succeeded: release/dedicated-autoscale v1.3.2 — 1934567902

Samira (VP Product): Heads-up: legal signed off on Acme Corp Private pilot addendum for EU data residency. Small pilot kickoff next Tue.

Ava (CEO): Two concrete asks: (1) PMs — prioritize the top 3 regression prompt sets in Redwood Optimize and make them high-risk flags for any model rollouts; (2) Recruiting — pause agency hiring for backend contractors until headcount sync on Friday. Details in the readout doc: https://redwood.ai/internal/q2-ops-readout

Ravi (Head of Eng): Noted. I'll post the routing rollback playbook and the canary checklist in #eng-runtime by EOD.

Elena (Director, Reliability): Scheduling a reliability review Thu 10:30 PT — invites going out to eng-sre, eng-runtime, and Product leads. We'll cover SLO delta reports and the GC circuit-breaker telemetry.

Ava (CEO): Appreciate the focus — small wins matter. Demo feedback was positive and the latest cohort retention nudged up. Keep the emphasis on reliable, predictable economics. :rocket:
